LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: warlike
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Quick to take up arms and slow to forgive.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: peaceful
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Prefers talk to war and keeps the peace when it can.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: mercantile
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Lives by trade: sends many caravans and values open roads.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: expansionist
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Hungry for land: founds new settlements and covets its neighbours'.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: isolationist
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Keeps to itself: little trade, little expansion, wary of strangers.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: honorable
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Keeps its word, remembers its debts.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: disciplined
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: A standing army in every town.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: zealous
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Its faith drives it: hostile to unbelievers, fervent in growth.

LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.label: marauders
LivingWorld.FactionTraitDef.description: Lives off plunder rather than work.
